info.title: apthermo
info.description: The apthermo command line: rocket propellant chemical equilibrium and performance (NASA CEA's class of computation), JSON in, JSON or CSV out.

commands.name: equilibrium
commands.description: one equilibrium state (tp, hp or sp) of a problem document

commands.name: rocket
commands.description: chamber, throat and exits of a rocket problem document

commands.name: schema
commands.description: the JSON Schema of a document shape; a missing or unknown name exits 2, naming the known schemas

commands.name: states
commands.description: state records (JSON array, JSON Lines, several files) as one batch

options.name: --output
options.description: write the document to PATH instead of standard output

options.name: --format
options.description: document format (default json; devices: json only)

options.name: --accelerator
options.description: where to solve (default: the document's engine.accelerator, else auto)

options.name: --database
options.description: directory with thermo.inp and trans.inp (default: the database bundled with apthermo)

options.name: --threshold
options.description: omit mole fractions below X from the compositions (default 5E-06)

options.name: --mass-tolerance
options.description: accept element moles whose mass differs from one kilogram by at most X, relative (default 0.01)

options.name: --transport
options.description: states: evaluate transport properties at every record

options.name: --version
options.description:
the tool's version
exit codes: 0 every case ok; 1 a case failed numerically (document written); 2 invalid input; 3 accelerator or infrastructure error
